result.summary: Found 3 visual layout issues: truncated restaurant names, popular card content clipped by the bottom navigation, and a cut-off filter pill.

issues.description: Restaurant names are truncated and cut off: 'Trattoria Piccol' on the right edge and 'Tokumaru Ramer' instead of 'Ramen' below the ramen image
issues.suggestion: Allow restaurant titles to wrap to two lines or expand card width, add proper text-overflow handling so full names are readable and not clipped

issues.description: Second card in 'Popular right now' section with -20% pizza image is flush against and clipped by the bottom tab bar with no spacing, hiding its title, rating and metadata
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and safe-area inset above the fixed tab bar so scrolling content is fully visible and not obscured

issues.description: Category filter row shows a partially cut-off empty pill on the far right edge after 'Healthy' with no visible label
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll container has proper end padding and all filter pills render fully with labels when scrolled into view
